abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Assist Workspace instance is supported.

data.max_age_days: Delete chats older than this many days (0 = never)
data.admin_can_view: Let admins review other users' chats
data.purge_removed_users: Delete the history of users who have been removed

data_description.max_conversations: Oldest unpinned chats are deleted first. Pinned chats are always kept.
data_description.admin_can_view: Shows the Chat Review page in the sidebar for admins. Every look at another user's chat is logged, and users see a notice.
data_description.purge_removed_users: Runs when a user account no longer exists.
